an3.104:1.1: Lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave assādapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yo loke assādo tad ajjhagamaṃ yāvatako loke assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho. Lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yo loke ādīnavo tad ajjhagamaṃ yāvatako loke ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho. Lokassāhaṃ bhikkhave nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ ācariṃ yaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ tad ajjhagamaṃ yāvatakaṃ loke nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me etaṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ. Yāvakīvañ cāhaṃ bhikkhave lokassa assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ n' eva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ. Yato ca khvāhaṃ bhikkhave lokassa assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrāhmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ, ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi -akuppā me cetovimutti ayaṃ antimā jāti n' atthi dāni punabbhavo ti.
